title: SMTP Tunnel Proxy: A networking tool that disguises your internet traffic as email communication
description:
SMTP Tunnel Proxy — a covert networking tool that disguises your internet traffic as harmless email communication to bypass Deep Packet Inspection. That means traffic from your browser, Git client, or anything else can be sent over what looks like legit SMTP handshake and mail flow — perfect for restricted networks where traditional VPNs get blocked.

https://github.com/x011/smtp-tunnel-proxy
